children: Shares of SoFi Technologies Inc. (SOFI) recovered after posting a 52-week low amid a selloff in financial stocks on Wednesday.
The stock slumped to an annual low of $11.95 during regular trading hours before recovering to close up 1.63% and continuing to climb in overnight trading.
While retail sentiment on Stocktwits remained ‘bearish’ over the past week, some traders eyed a leg-up in the stock in the future.
Retail Goes Bottom Fishing
Retail chatter around
climbed 76% on Stocktwits, according to platform data.
One user
, “$SOFI GREEN on string volume a very good sign we may have hit bottom.”
Another user
, “$SOFI Sofi is poised for an Epic move higher: Why? Look at the numbers, they do not lie. Wall Street can play games but the Numbers do not Lie!”
A third user said, “$SOFI scared yet? This is where ya make money in the long run.”
However, one user pointed out, “$SOFI today is going to hurt boys. This is a $3 stock trading at $12. Make that make sense.”
Yet another user said, “$SOFI why buy now when we all know it's going below 10? A realistic valuation has this in the 4-6 range. Why buy a bubble company when the bubble is popping?”
SOFI Stock: Q3 Snapshot
At the end of October, SoFi Technologies reported record-breaking third-quarter 2026 financial results, beating consensus estimates and raising its full-year guidance.
Revenue rose 44% year-over-year to a record $1.4 billion, while GAAP net income reached $241 million, with diluted earnings per share of $0.18.

Fee-based revenue climbed to $570.6 million, accounting for 42% of total revenue. Lending segment adjusted revenue jumped 68% year-over-year to $807.4 million, powered by record total loan originations of $16.9 billion.
Meanwhile, financial services segment revenue grew 25% year-over-year to $525.1 million.
The financial company added nearly 1.2 million new members, bringing the total member count up 35% year-over-year to 17.1 million.
It also added 2.2 million new products, bringing total products up 44% year-over-year to 26.7 million.

SoFi raised its full-year 2026 adjusted net revenue guidance to $5.04 billion and adjusted EBITDA to $1.66 billion. For fiscal year 2027, SoFi projected $6.4 billion in adjusted net revenue, $2.24 billion in adjusted EBITDA, and $0.90 in EPS.
SOFI stock is down 50% year-to-date.
